_comment: Cross-rack reuse demo (CPU-ONLY baseline) — identical NPU/CPU to cross_rack_jbof.json but NO pod-wide tiers at all (no JBOF, no COLDSTORE). The CPU tier is per-node, so a context tray 0 evicts to its CPU is INVISIBLE to tray 1: there is no shared tier, cross-rack reuse is impossible, and tray 1 must RECOMPUTE the prefill. Run: --tier-policy exclusive --prefix-storage CPU --request-routing-policy CUSTOM --cpu-scope per_node --max-num-seqs 1 --enable-prefix-caching --enable-prefix-sharing
